name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
This update: a cleaner, sturdier Today screen.
Who to chase now shows each customer's phone number with a one-tap Call, next to Remind.
Add a missing number right on Today: the moment you tap it, add the mobile for the customers who owe you but cannot be reached - no jumping to another screen.
Accurate counts: Today only counts customers who OWE you and have no number (a handful), never every party in your books. Customers you marked do-not-chase no longer appear in the chase list.
The Today tab stays Today: opening a payment or a customer no longer leaves the Today screen stuck on another page.
Sturdier display: the page no longer goes blank on a hiccup - it keeps your last view and recovers on its own.

Also included from the previous update: the Today home itself; trade-based due dates (electricals 60 days) when Tally has none; a fairer reliability score where one late bill among many paid does not drag the customer down; a money-in alert when a customer says they paid; your WhatsApp login surviving updates; and a one-tap 'confirm your balance' you can send a customer at most once every 90 days.
